user_story: As a new user I can add the marketplace, install petry, and invoke all three skills in a fresh session.
expected_behavior: The documented marketplace commands install version 0.7.0 and a fresh Claude/Cowork session discovers manage-assets, capture, and get-asset-data.
test_evidence: claude plugin validate; claude plugin details; installed-only lifecycle eval; native Cowork session
latest_test_result: Marketplace install reported 0.7.0 enabled; all three skills discovered; native get-asset-data and capture invocations passed
notes: Installed and tested from the GitHub marketplace without a development plugin override.

user_story: As an operations user I can create, edit, rename, link, archive, restore, and list local assets.
expected_behavior: Stable project-local identities and relationships survive names and sessions without requiring a database.
latest_test_result: Identity and management contract tests pass

user_story: As an operations user I can bind different systems to different asset datasets and reuse those choices later.
expected_behavior: Exact dataset/metric/grain preferences resolve deterministically; failures do not silently switch or combine sources.
notes: Production and real-time sources remain independent.

user_story: As an operations user I can ask for an asset profile, chart, table, comparison, or grouped overview.
expected_behavior: Claude reads connected data, computes supported figures, and creates a component-first artifact without invented measurements.
latest_test_result: Contract tests and native Cowork acceptance pass
notes: Native rendering remains a manual acceptance surface.

feature: Explicit type and exact fact fidelity
user_story: As a user I can log an exact typed observation and trust the stored record.
expected_behavior: An explicitly requested type is preserved and exact fact text is byte-faithful after serialization.
latest_test_result: Three fresh live lifecycle runs passed after hardening
errors: Earlier runs recategorized an event and altered exact fact text
notes: Non-negotiable input fidelity now appears at the top of the capture skill.

user_story: As a user I can repeat a capture without duplication and correct an exact observation without losing history.
expected_behavior: Duplicates are byte-identical no-ops; corrections expire and link the predecessor while preserving unrelated data.

user_story: As a user I see a captured insight update the affected chart, timeline, details, and summary only.
expected_behavior: Relevant changes refresh the same artifact; unrelated or duplicate changes do not; corrections remove stale projections.
test_evidence: test/agent-eval-oracle.test.mjs; pnpm eval:agent 3/3 final runs; docs/tasks/local-acceptance.md
latest_test_result: Same identity and revision behavior passed 3/3
errors: Oracle initially rejected a valid dotted petry.type projection
notes: Oracle now accepts nested, dotted, and generic valid projection shapes.

user_story: As a user I can save a presentation template by asset/view type and reuse it in a fresh session.
expected_behavior: Declarative templates retain layout choices without data, credentials, source IDs, or executable instructions.
test_evidence: test/artifact-template-contract.test.mjs; docs/tasks/artifact-templates.md; native installed-only Cowork smoke
latest_test_result: Merged implementation and installed Cowork template reuse passed
notes: The saved Standard well profile template resolved in a fresh installed-plugin session.

user_story: As a nontechnical operations user I see familiar labels and calendar dates rather than storage fields.
expected_behavior: Visible and accessible UI omits UUIDs, schema fields, paths, connector IDs, hashes, raw JSON, and exact timestamps unless requested.
latest_test_result: Same private artifact republished and event dialog visually verified
errors: Old artifact exposed world time, precision, knowledge timestamp, UUID, and paths

user_story: As an installer I receive a valid instruction-only plugin without vulnerable runtime dependencies.
expected_behavior: Manifest validates, only three skill directories ship, and dependency audit is clean.
test_evidence: claude plugin validate; pnpm audit --prod; pnpm run check
errors: Original dirty checkout contains an untracked build directory
notes: Build/release from a clean checkout; preserve the user's local build files.

user_story: As a maintainer I can catch model-mediated capture and refresh regressions before release.
expected_behavior: A disposable stateful harness independently validates four lifecycle cases and retains failed evidence.
test_evidence: test/agent-eval-oracle.test.mjs; pnpm eval:agent 3/3 final runs; installed-only eval
latest_test_result: Working-tree reliability sample passed 3/3 and installed marketplace build passed all four lifecycle cases
notes: The runner now supports explicit installed-plugin release verification.

user_story: As an installer I can identify and install the intended immutable release.
expected_behavior: The final main commit is tagged and a GitHub release identifies version, changes, validation, and install instructions.
latest_test_result: Immutable tag and GitHub release published from the exact verified commit

user_story: As a team I can opt into a shared service without breaking local use.
expected_behavior: The free plugin stays local-first; shared database, permissions, billing, and transfer remain a separate service contract.
errors: Paid service is intentionally outside this repository
notes: Do not market the shared backend as implemented by this plugin release.

feature: Custom entities and parent insight scope
user_story: I can create default or custom entity types and read consolidated or individual insights.
expected_behavior: Explicit contains/parent_of traversal deduplicates shared descendants and multi-subject notes; fresh direct views find notes across all vault files.
latest_test_result: Sonnet/high clean run passed 12 turns; 37 deterministic tests pass on Linux/Windows
errors: Earlier model/oracle failures documented in task log
notes: Unreleased PR #20. Headless adapter evidence; native Cowork previews and external connectors not tested.
